messages:
zoe: SigmaCorp POC blocked: SCIM returns 403 'token scope' and SAML redirects back to wrong ACS (RelayState points to internal app). They mentioned rotating hosted API keys during our Dedicated/VPC cutover. Need quick triage.
marc: can you paste the SCIM error snippet and the SAML assertion/RelayState? Also confirm which key string they put into the Dedicated console.
zoe: logs: 
```
scim-proxy: 403 forbidden - token audience mismatch (hosted -> cannot access /dedicated/sigma)
http: redirect received with RelayState=https://internal.sigma-app.local/callback (expected our ACS)
```
henry: two things: 1) hosted key used against dedicated path -> 403, 2) RelayState tells SP where to send users after SSO. If their IdP app is configured with a generic RelayState, they need a dedicated SAML app for Redwood with correct ACS + RelayState or remove RelayState.
zoe: they pasted 'rudx-xx12' (hosted). They also use a regional SCIM endpoint (eu.scim.redwood.company) but pasted the global path into Dedicated console. That caused token audience check to fail because tenant tokens are region-scoped.
marc: quick fixes: issue a short-lived tenant token for eu region and ask IdP to update SAML app's RelayState / ACS to values in our metadata. Also update SCIM connector URL to https://eu.scim.redwood.company/dedicated/sigma/Users.
henry: I'll mint a temp token: rudx-tenant-eu-temp-sigma-3h and DM it. Also note: if RelayState must be preserved per their workflow, have them set the app's default RelayState to our ACS path or handle mapping on their side.
idp-bot: issued temporary token rudx-tenant-eu-temp-sigma-3h (valid until 2165127200).
zoe: provided curl test for them: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer rudx-tenant-eu-temp-sigma-3h" https://eu.scim.redwood.company/dedicated/sigma/Users`
marc: customer ran it -> 200 + users list. SCIM provisioning resumed. For SAML we sent metadata and asked them to create a dedicated app. They updated RelayState and ACS; re-tested SSO -> success.
henry: follow-up: we'll add console validation to detect region mismatch in SCIM URL and warn when a hosted-style key is pasted into tenant fields. Filing INFRA-521.
zoe: SigmaCorp confirmed POC provisioning + SSO. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
